offering_description.value: Designs, manufactures and markets branded personal care products including razors and blades, sun care, feminine care, and grooming products. Sells to consumers mainly through mass retailers, grocery, drug stores and online retailers.

primary_products.value: razors and blades; sun care lotions and sprays; feminine care pads and tampons; shaving creams and gels; grooming products

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers buying shaving, sun care, feminine care and grooming products; B2B: retailers and distributors that stock its brands

end_markets.value: personal care; wet shave and grooming; sun care; feminine care

revenue_model.value: product sales: branded personal care products sold to retailers and consumers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns consumer brands, sells to retailers and consumers; OEM / manufacturer: manufactures razors, sun care and feminine care products in own plants from purchased materials

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: wet shave, sun care, feminine care and grooming products sold to the same consumers and retailers

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: mass merchandisers, grocery, drug stores and club stores; online: e-commerce retailers and direct-to-consumer sites; distributors / dealers: distributors serving international markets

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: sunscreen is an over-the-counter drug regulated by FDA, cosmetics and product safety rules, plus environmental rules, apply
